Master.f2.city_config: Estimate-review $ threshold + reviewer role — pure city policy (recommend: supervisor review over $50).

Estimate-Fee.addt.city_config: ⚠ Not-estimable-yet path (prelim search first) — pure city policy on when allowed and its operational target.

Estimate-Fee.fcom.city_config: Estimate communication template; itemization statutory where fee.estimate_and_notice requires it.

Estimate-Fee.drsp.city_config: ⚠ config-not-law: requester response window on the estimate. Recommend default 30d.

Estimate-Fee.ddep.label: Deposit / pay before

Estimate-Fee.cnp.city_config: ⚠ nonpayment close window: statutory MO 90d · OR 60d · TX 60d · MI 45d (deposit); else city default (recommend 60d).

production.format_and_medium.summary: A requester may elect to obtain copies in any and all media in which the agency is capable of providing them.

production.no_medium_refusal.summary: A request for copies in a particular medium may not be denied on the ground that the custodian has made or prefers another medium.

production.inspection_access.summary: An agency is not required to respond to copy requests outside of its usual business hours.

production.no_duty_to_create_or_convert.summary: An agency is not required to respond by creating or compiling a record that does not exist.
An agency is not required to put into electronic medium a record that is not kept in electronic medium.
An agency is not required to create a computer database it has not otherwise created or is not otherwise required to create.

eligibility.any_person.summary: Any person may inspect, examine, and obtain copies of public records held by a custodian; access is not limited to a class of requesters.

eligibility.no_purpose_requirement.summary: A requester may not be required to disclose the purpose or motive for inspecting, examining, or copying public records.

eligibility.no_residency_requirement.summary: There is no residency requirement to request public records; access runs to any person.

Clarification.deny.label: Deny as vague / overbroad
Clarification.deny.note: Deny-as-vague is narrower than reasonably-describes membership: TN·NJ·OH, OK only after SB 535 engagement (diagram legend, v2.2).

Estimate-Fee.proc.label: No → proceed to work; collect at end
Estimate-Fee.proc.note: Collect-at-end is the default path wherever production is NOT statutorily conditioned on prepayment.

Records-Search.prog.label: BUT extraction/programming of EXISTING

production.no_duty_to_create_or_convert.summary: An agency is not required to respond by creating or compiling a record that does not exist.
An agency is not required to put into electronic medium a record that is not kept in electronic medium.
An agency is not required to create a computer database it has not otherwise created or is not otherwise required to create.

Records-Search.prog.note: Programming-≠-creation loop is TX 552.231 only; the broader no-duty-to-create concept (16 states) is context, not an activator.

production.website_satisfies.summary: An agency may satisfy the access/copy duty by making records available online in a viewable, printable/savable format; if so maintained, it need not provide copies any other way.

An agency may satisfy the § 132-6 database-access duty by making database records individually available online (viewable/printable/savable), but must still allow inspection of any such records it also maintains in a nondigital medium.

special_records.special_production_const.summary: Inspection or copying of a record that could be damaged due to its age or condition may be made subject to reasonable restrictions intended to preserve the record.

special_records.special_record_window.summary: Records relating to the proposed expansion or location of a specific business or industrial project may be withheld so long as inspection or copying would frustrate the purpose for which they were created.
Once the withholding basis no longer applies, the agency must disclose the requested announced-project records (not otherwise confidential) as soon as practicable and within 25 business days.
special_records.special_record_window.clock_spec: 25 business-days from the point the withholding basis ceases (as soon as practicable)

special_records.special_record_window.summary: Once the qualifying-site withholding basis no longer applies, the agency must disclose the requested qualifying-site records (not otherwise confidential) as soon as practicable and within 25 business days.
special_records.special_record_window.clock_spec: 25 business-days from the point the withholding basis ceases (as soon as practicable)

special_records.third_party_proprietary.summary: A political subdivision may not withhold or deny access on the basis of a nondisclosure agreement entered to restrict access to records subject to disclosure.

Disposition.caps.label: REQUESTOR-LEDGER CHECK (class D)
Disposition.caps.note: Requestor-ledger class-D delivery caps (OH) ride on ledger config; see ledger section.

fee.labor_charge.summary: When separation of confidential from nonconfidential information is necessary to permit access, the public agency bears the cost of separation.

fee.actual_cost_basis.summary: An agency may not charge a fee for an uncertified copy of a public record that exceeds the actual cost to the agency of making the copy.
fee.actual_cost_basis.clock_spec: ceiling: actual cost of making the copy

fee.electronic_media_charge.summary: An agency may assess different fees for different media, as prescribed by law.

fee.certified_copy_charge.summary: A requester may request certified or uncertified copies; fees for certifying copies are as provided by law.

fee.special_service_charge.summary: Where a request requires extensive use of information technology resources or extensive clerical/supervisory assistance, the agency may charge a reasonable special service charge (based on actual cost) in addition to duplication cost.
If an agency voluntarily elects, as a service, to create or compile a record, it may negotiate a reasonable charge for the service with the requester.
